properties.query:
let factor = 3.0;
let minDaily = 10;
let minBaselineDays = 3;
let secretViews = DelineaAuditEvents_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where Level == "PrivilegedActivity"
    | extend d = parse_json(RawData)
    | where tostring(d.eventType.name) == "Delinea.Vault.Secret.Viewed"
    | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SrcIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(Actor);
let baseline = secretViews
    | where TimeGenerated < ago(1d)
    | summarize Accesses = count() by Actor, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
    | summarize BaselineAvg = avg(Accesses), BaselineStdev = stdev(Accesses), BaselineMax = max(Accesses), DaysObserved = count() by Actor;
secretViews
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)
| summarize TodayAccesses = count(), DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId), Secrets = make_set(SecretId, 50),
            SourceIPs = make_set(SrcIP, 20), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by Actor
| join kind=inner baseline on Actor
| where DaysObserved >= minBaselineDays
| extend AnomalyThreshold = round(BaselineAvg + factor * BaselineStdev, 1)
| where TodayAccesses > AnomalyThreshold and TodayAccesses >= minDaily
| extend DeviationFactor = round(todouble(TodayAccesses) / (BaselineAvg + 1), 1)
| extend SrcIP = tostring(SourceIPs[0])
| project Actor, TodayAccesses, DistinctSecrets, BaselineAvg = round(BaselineAvg, 1), BaselineStdev = round(BaselineStdev, 1),
          BaselineMax, AnomalyThreshold, DeviationFactor, DaysObserved, Secrets, SrcIP, StartTime, EndTime
| sort by DeviationFactor desc
properties.description:
Detects when a user's secret-access volume for the current day significantly exceeds their own
recent baseline (per-user daily average plus a standard-deviation factor over the prior ~14 days).
A sudden spike relative to a principal's normal behaviour can indicate a compromised privileged
account or insider misuse. Tune 'factor' and 'minDaily' to balance noise against coverage.
properties.name: Delinea - Privileged account access anomaly (secret-access volume vs baseline)
